sources.title: Model2 | openai/dalle-2-preview | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview and Purpose This document provides detailed information about Model2, one of the two models showcased in the DALL-E 2 Preview repository. Model2 offers expanded capabilities beyond standard image generation, including image variations and inpainting functionality. For information about the simpler model with fewer features, see Model1.
